title: Win a copy of our book! Share your thoughts & ideas on Beautiful News
content:
Our evidence-based optimism project @beautifulnews.daily returns next week! Launching Oct 12th.

A chart a day surfacing & visualising amazing, progressive and positive things happening around the world.

The stuff we can’t always see when fixated on the negativity of the news.

Ahead our reboot, we’d like to find out a bit more about you – who you are, why you might be interested in Beautiful News type stories and how we can improve.

So if you remember and like Beautiful News, feel free to fill in our quick 4-minute survey. Every hundredth person wins a copy of our book.

Thanking you!
